title: Show a stale or unsupported remote verification delivery on its destination item as uncredited history
outcome: Show a stale or unsupported remote verification delivery on its destination item as uncredited history
acceptance: A remote verification delivery whose destination check fails (association_stale) or whose producer is unsupported, and that names an existing item in this project, appears in that item's show as uncredited history with its reason and detail
Its qualification, credit and the item's evidence are unchanged: it cannot be cited as run evidence, earns no credit and writes no verification
docs/features/execution-observability.md (remote verification visibility) describes the new item-level listing; a store test and a show rendering test cover it
